Africa Maths Initiative, volunteer

Education

Hands-on, gamified maths camps for learners across East Africa, with evaluation built in from the start.

  • Designed and facilitated gamified maths lessons at residential and community camps
  • Built baseline and endline tools, analysed the data and contributed to camp reports
  • Co-authored two maths camp papers and presented the AMI camps at AFRICME7

Kenya Agroecology Hub partnership

Agriculture

Farmer Research Networks and CRFS grantees in western Kenya, supported end to end from field protocol to dashboard.

  • Directly supported 10 partner organisations working in agroecology
  • Kobo tools, enumerator training, field protocols, data cleaning and analysis
  • Dashboards in Python, Excel and R Shiny that partners use to track farmers

Global Parenting Initiative with NIMR Mwanza

Parenting Initiative

Field support for the ParentApp for Teens randomised controlled trial in Mwanza, Tanzania, in collaboration with the National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR), Mwanza Centre.

  • Worked in collaboration with the National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR), Mwanza Centre
  • Supported the field team to collect consent forms from caregivers
  • Followed up with participants, documented problems with the ParentApp on their phones and resolved them where possible

Agriculture

Field Assessment Report: Improving Farmer Training on AE Practices

Endline evaluationCo-authorCFHF

Endline evaluation of one-week agroecology training with 10 partner organisations across 42 sub-counties in western Kenya. 223 farmers and 63 practices assessed; 48 practices rose. Co-authored with Muchugia Susan for the Kenya Agroecology Hub, funded by the Conservation Food and Health Foundation.
